description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, we sit down with Mia Hibbert, owner of the Atlanta Wild, to talk about the challenges of being a female business owner in industries where women have historically been underrepresented.

Mia shares her experience navigating the sports, fitness, and coaching world while also reflecting on the doubts that can arise when you're different from the people around you. As a woman and a minority, she talks about learning to push past those questions and stay focused on her purpose.

One of the biggest takeaways from this conversation is that you cannot let fear, comparison, or other people's expectations determine your path.

The people who are meant to work with you, learn from you, and support you will be drawn to you for a reason.

Keep showing up anyway.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, leadership lessons, and real-world discussions.
